import pandas as pd

data = pd.read_csv("data.csv")

# Sleep Duration vs BMI with Sleep Disorder

ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration by BMI Category')

ax2.set_title('Quality of Sleep by BMI Category')
ax2.set_xlabel('BMI Category')
ax2.set_ylabel('Average Quality of Sleep')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("output.png")
